name: Pinball Arcade: White Water
storyline: White Water (1993): is another awesome Williams table designed by Dennis Nordman, who also designed great games such as Scared Stiff, Elvira and the Party Monsters and Dr. Dude And His Excellent Ray. The game challenges players with navigating down the river to Wet Willies River Ranch by completing flashing hazard shots. This is a fast playing game with many wild, white water rafting themed shots and several Multi-Ball modes. The playfield features an easily distracted Bigfoot and a Whirlpool that sucks the ball down. 7,008 units of this table were produced.
